explanation: Israel's first king, chosen by God through the prophet Samuel.
Prophet and judge in Israel, who served as a mediator between God and the people.
A hostile tribe that attacked the Israelites during their exodus from Egypt.
Another name for God, emphasizing his sovereignty and authority.
To follow instructions and commands given by a higher power, in this case God.
To show regret or sorrow over past actions, especially those that are sinful or contrary to God's will.
The king of the Amalekites, whom Saul captured instead of killing him, in violation of God's command.
Individuals or groups selected by God for a specific purpose, as was the case with Saul and Israel.
When God no longer accepts an individual or group due to their disobedience or sin.
